_comment: Owned numbers for tools/docs/check_claims.py. Each claim names its owning document, the value the owner fixes, a pattern that captures the value in the owner, and the other files that state it (including module/ship/ship_core.cpp, the arbiter for what is built). A source whose capture disagrees, or stops matching, fails the check. Scope: only registered claims are checked; docs/evidence/ is deliberately not scanned because it is a dated record allowed to hold superseded values with an annotation.

claims.description: the main computer core is on deck 10 (auxiliary on deck 7)

sources.pattern: computer core and the torpedo launchers are on deck (\d+)

claims.description: the modelled torpedo launchers (the fore tubes) are on deck 10; the aft tubes are on deck 4

sources.pattern: computer core and the torpedo launchers are on deck (\d+)
